# spatial-structures.types: LooseOctree3D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> An octree whose node bounds are enlarged by the factor Looseness (1 means
> exact; 2 is common), letting each item live wholly inside one node:
> cheap incremental updates for moving objects. Instances come from
> BuildLooseOctree (spatial-structures.library.plato) or from a host.
